title: ReplayRun
description: Level 2 Historical Replay Engine milestone: one attempt to replay a single Snapshot's decision-time inputs. Research-only -- never read by the production pipeline. See docs/REPLAY_ENGINE.md.

replayRunId.description: sha1('replay_run', snapshotId, replayMode, candidateModelCommitSha-or-empty, replayFrameworkVersion) -- see lib/edgelab/replay.py:build_replay_run_id. Deterministic and write-once per this key: a second attempt with identical inputs verifies-and-no-ops rather than producing a duplicate run.

snapshotId.description: The PRE_GAME_DECISION snapshotId this run replayed.

snapshotManifestHash.description: The exact snapshot manifestHash this run consumed, pinned verbatim -- proves which exact (hash-verified) version of the snapshot produced this replay's results, even if the underlying snapshot were somehow superseded later.

productionRunId.description: The snapshot's own productionRunId (productionRunKey), copied verbatim, when the snapshot is run-keyed (PRE_GAME_DECISION always is).

workflowRunId.description: GitHub Actions run_id of the workflow invocation that created this replay run, when running in Actions; null for local/manual runs.

replayFrameworkVersion.description: Version of this replay engine itself (lib.edgelab.replay.REPLAY_FRAMEWORK_VERSION) -- distinct from candidateModelCommitSha, since the replay adapter code can change independent of the model code it calls.

replayMode.description: CANDIDATE_MODEL: runs the current (or a specified) checkout's production functions against the snapshot's frozen decision-time inputs. HISTORICAL_PRODUCTION: would check out and execute the exact historical production commit -- UNSUPPORTED in this milestone (see docs/REPLAY_ENGINE.md) -- any run requesting it gets runStatus=REJECTED_UNSUPPORTED_MODE, never a fabricated result.

candidateModelCommitSha.description: git commit SHA of the checkout that actually executed CANDIDATE_MODEL replay (same convention as lib/edgelab/snapshot.py's snapshotWriterCommitSha). Suffixed '-dirty' (standard git convention) when the working tree had uncommitted changes to tracked files at execution time -- see limitationReasons' CANDIDATE_WORKING_TREE_DIRTY -- so a dirty run's identity can never be confused with, or collide with, a clean run at the same commit.

candidateModelVersion.description: Optional human label for the candidate (e.g. a research branch name); no versioning scheme beyond commit SHA exists in this repository today, so this is null unless a caller supplies one explicitly.

productionModelCommitSha.description: Copied verbatim from the snapshot's own productionCommitSha -- always null today (documented gap: no upstream artifact records its own producing commit). Ambiguity here is exactly what makes HISTORICAL_PRODUCTION replay unsupported and caps replayFidelity below LEVEL_3_CODE_PINNED.

pricingVersions.description: Copied verbatim from the snapshot's pricingVersionsByFamily.

replayFidelity.description: Mechanically derived from eligibilityStatus (see lib/edgelab/replay.py:derive_replay_fidelity_from_eligibility) -- never a narrative judgment, and never LEVEL_3_CODE_PINNED while productionModelCommitSha is null.

eligibilityStatus.description: See lib/edgelab/replay.py:assess_replay_eligibility's exact rule table (docs/REPLAY_ENGINE.md). Independent of (but informed by) the snapshot's own completenessStatus -- Level 2 replay eligibility is a narrower, replay-specific concept. RESEARCH_ONLY_NO_DECISION (corpus-health audit, 2026-08-25 follow-up): a schedule-triggered run never had an authoritative, risk-gated decision to begin with -- distinct from the INELIGIBLE_* family, which all mean a decision existed but this snapshot fails to support replaying it.

runStatus.description: REJECTED_INELIGIBLE: eligibility check failed and the caller did not explicitly request Level 1 approximate mode. REJECTED_UNSUPPORTED_MODE: HISTORICAL_PRODUCTION was requested. FAILED: an unexpected error during execution (never a partial/fabricated result). NOT_APPLICABLE_NO_DECISION: schedule-triggered run with no authoritative decision to replay -- never a rejection or failure, an honest by-design outcome.

limitationReasons.description: Deduplicated union of every limitation this run is honestly subject to, e.g. EFFECTIVE_CONFIG_PARTIAL, PRODUCTION_COMMIT_UNKNOWN, SETTLEMENT_UNAVAILABLE, CLV_UNAVAILABLE, APPROXIMATE_FIDELITY_REQUESTED.

summary.description: Denormalized counts for fast lookup without scanning every ReplayResult.

manifestHash.description: SHA-256 over this ReplayRun's own canonical, content-only serialization (startedAt/completedAt/provenance excluded -- 'when' facts, not 'what'), same convention as lib/edgelab/snapshot.py's manifestHash.

performance.description: Item 8's scoring report over this run's settlement-resolved markets only (lib/edgelab/replay.py:score_resolved_results). Null (not a fabricated all-zero report) when zero markets resolved this run -- see summary.settledResolved for that count. Applies the existing calibration.py sample-size gate (n<20/n<100/n>=100) as a mandatory reading instruction, never a filter that withholds a computed number.

roi.description: Always null this milestone: ROI requires a real staked amount, and a replayed decision is research-only -- it may never have been placed as a real PlacedBet with a real stake. Fabricating a flat-unit stake would invent data never actually risked. The field exists (per item 8's report list) but stays null until a real staking/ledger link is designed -- see docs/REPLAY_ENGINE.md.
